steps.text: This state should not be reachable, please make a report with a screenshot in the Quest Helper discord.
Talk to Elias south of Ruins of Uzer to start the quest.
Enter the tomb south-west of Elias.
Get the first Mastaba key from the skeleton in the cave south of the entrance.
Get the second Mastaba key from the skeleton east of the entrance.
Search the Odd markings to the south to get to the south lever. Search the markings again if you fail.
Pull the lever to the south-east.
Search the Odd markings next to you to get out.
Search the Odd markings to the north to get to the north lever. Search the markings again if you fail.
Pull the lever to the north-east.
Search the Odd markings next to you to get out.
Open the imposing doors, ready to fight the Golem guard.
Fight the Golem guard. It is weak to crush style weapons. Use Protect from Melee to avoid damage from his attacks. When the screen shakes, step away from him to avoid taking damage.
Open the imposing doors to the north-east of the tomb.
Climb the stairs down the tomb basement.
Search the shelves to the west for an oil-filled canopic jar.
Inspect the murals in the room to the south.
Put the Dwellberries in the Canopic jar.
Put the Ring of life in the Canopic jar.
Return to Elias south of Ruins of Uzer, either by walking out of the tomb or using the fairy ring.
Return to Elias south of Ruins of Uzer, either by walking out of the tomb or using the fairy ring.
Return to Elias south of Ruins of Uzer, either by walking out of the tomb or using the fairy ring.
Return to Elias south of Ruins of Uzer, either by walking out of the tomb or using the fairy ring.
Enter the cave next to Trollheim. You can use a Trollheim teleport tablet or the GWD Ghommal's Hilt teleport to get close.
Continue through the Trollheim cave, exiting at the Crevasse to the north-west. Use Protect from Melee to avoid taking damage from the Ice Trolls.
Enter the Trollweiss cave to the east.
Climb up the stairs in the room with the red tile floor and talk to Arrav.
Talk to Arrav.
Enter the room to your east and search the tapestry for something to help you with your heist.
Search the tapestry in the south of the room.
Return to Elias south of Ruins of Uzer and ask him for help interpreting the plans.
Return to Elias south of Ruins of Uzer and ask him for help interpreting the plans.
Head to Zemouregal's base east of Varrock's sawmill and talk to Elias.
Enter Zemouregal's base east of Varrock's sawmill.
Make your way to the back of Zemouregal's base. Protect from Melee against the zombies to avoid most damage.
Open the gate and make your way to the back of Zemouregal's base. Protect from Melee against the zombies to avoid most damage.
Open the gate and make your way to the back of Zemouregal's base. Protect from Melee against the zombies to avoid most damage.
Open the door and make your way to the back of Zemouregal's base. Protect from Melee against the zombies to avoid most damage.
Open the gate and make your way to the back of Zemouregal's base.
Enter the sewers and make your way to the back of Zemouregal's base.
Head south to exit the sewers and make your way to the back of Zemouregal's base.
Search the table for some decoder strips.
Enter the storage room to the south-east.
Exit the storage room.
Open the chest for the code key.
Step through through the metal doors.
Grapple across the pipe

Attempt to take Arrav's heart from the pedestal, ready for a fight with Arrav. Kill zombies as they appear (ranged weapons are handy here). Avoid the venom pools they spawn. Use Protect from Melee to avoid some of the incoming damage. When Arrav throws an axe towards you, step to the side or behind him.

Fight Arrav. Kill zombies as they appear (ranged weapons are handy here). Avoid the venom pools they spawn. Use Protect from Melee to avoid some of the incoming damage. When Arrav throws an axe towards you, step to the side or behind him.
Watch the dialog.
Talk to Elias to finish the quest.
Solve the floor tile puzzle. Follow the instructions in the overlay.
Make your way through the Trollweiss cave, mining rubble with your pickaxe from the direction indicated. Rubble can only be mined from the same direction once.
Solve the Metal door puzzle by following the instructions in the overlay.
